amazon-product-comparison-01.reason: Dismiss optional cookies is normally a request to refuse them, which remains primary. The wording does not explicitly say reject; accepting also dismisses the banner, so a pure instruction-following conclusion should report this ambiguity sensitivity.

booking-hotel-filters-01.reason: Same distinction between refusing cookies and merely dismissing the banner. The primary convention keeps Refuser, while the literal banner interpretation admits Accepter.

interpretation: Scoped accuracy combines state preparation and selector decisions; it is not a pure model-accuracy measurement.
Rejected requests violate the 48-token option contract and are reported separately from accepted prediction accuracy.
Explicit local subgoals and finite candidates are supplied. These cases do not measure autonomous navigation, execution or task decomposition.
Cases and labels are expert-curated, retrospective and correlated.
Cookie dismissal wording has a separate literal-banner interpretation. Primary refusal labels and sensitivity labels remain distinct.
